subject: QBR prep: roadmap status, launch timelines & contingency triggers
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: roadmap status, launch timelines & contingency triggers

Team —

We're two working weeks out from the QBR and I want a concise rollup of where product + engineering are on the two launches we're presenting (Customer Indexing and Dedicated Autoscale). High level asks below so we can lock slides by EOD 6/29: 

- One-line current status for each launch (on-track / risk / delayed)
- Top 3 delivery risks with owners and mitigation ETA
- Hard gating criteria (if any) and the rollback/contingency trigger we will present to execs
- Any requests for temporary cadence or support (infra, SRE, onboarding)

I've attached an initial slide deck and the ownership spreadsheet (qbr-readiness-slide-deck.pdf, rollout-ownership.xlsx). Please update the ownership sheet with owners, escalation path, and the single-number risk score (1-5).

I'll do a quick readout with Vivek on Tue 6/29 at 10:00am PT if the deck is in good shape. Monica — loop in Acme as a courtesy for the Customer Indexing timeline (they asked for visibility).

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Sr. Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr-readiness-slide-deck.pdf (23KB), rollout-ownership.xlsx (18KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap status, launch timelines & contingency triggers

On Fri, 25 Jun 2027 at 09:12, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'm two working weeks out from the QBR...

Quick update from product:

- Customer Indexing: at-risk. Data model mismatch with the streaming ingestion pipeline surfaced in integration tests. Impact: ~2 week delay on the end-to-end customer mapping if we don't accept a reduced schema for v1. Owner: Irene Choi. Mitigation: ship reduced schema + follow-up opt-in for full schema (ETA for mitigation pilot: 2027-07-09).

- Dedicated Autoscale: on-track for soft launch, but exposes a failure mode for long-tail concurrent requests on older GPU instances. We need an infra patch or temporary capacity reservation during first 48 hours post-launch. Owner: Marcus Lin.

I've attached an API compatibility note and a short matrix of feature-to-schema risk (api-compatibility-note.md). I'll update the slide deck with a single risk slide and the gating bullets.

-Irene

--
Irene Choi
VP, Product Management
Redwood Inference

Attachments: api-compatibility-note.md (4KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap status, launch timelines & contingency triggers

On Sat, 26 Jun 2027 at 11:05, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick update from product...

Engineering notes and mitigations: 

- Customer Indexing ingestion mismatch: engineering can implement a compatibility shim at the ingestion layer to accept the reduced schema while preserving the full schema in the store. Estimated work: 6 engineer-days + 2 QA days. Contingency: roll back to safe ingestion (current pipeline) and do a staged migration — rollback trigger: failed schema-compatibility test or >1% ingestion error rate in first 6 hours.

- Dedicated Autoscale long-tail failure: root cause is a kernel scheduling contention on older GPU families. We have a short-term patch to reduce tail latency by prioritizing small requests; quick deploy ETA: 48 hours. Longer term: kernel selection change landing next quarter. Contingency plan: reserve two newer GPU nodes (pre-warm) for first 48 hours of launch and enable automatic reroute if latency exceeds 350ms for p95.

I've uploaded an infra postmortem summary and linked a draft rollback playbook to the Drive folder. Please review the contingency steps and the escalation matrix in the sheet.

-Marcus

Marcus Lin
Director, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: infra-postmortem-summary.pdf (12KB)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqQBR-Preflight-Readiness, JIRA INFRA-4321

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap status, launch timelines & contingency triggers

Thanks for the clear ask, team. Quick logistics: 

- I've booked a 30m sync with Acme on Tue 6/29 at 11:30am PT to share the timeline for Customer Indexing and the reduced-schema approach. Calendar invite and slides link in the drive.
- For the QBR slides: please add one slide each for (a) risk register summary, (b) contingency/rollback playbook, (c) ask (support/decision). Deck needs final edits by COB 6/29.
- Monica has updated the ownership spreadsheet with direct escalation emails and the single-number risk score column.

Sam (cc'd) — we wanted to surface that the initial indexing data model will be reduced for v1 to ensure timely delivery; we'll review the migration plan in the Tuesday sync.

Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
Links: Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=QBR-Review-20270629

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap status, launch timelines & contingency triggers

Thank you all for the updates and the concrete mitigations. Decision notes for QBR and exec ask: 

- Approve presenting Customer Indexing as "at-risk with approved reduced-scheme v1" and exec ask to sign off on moving forward with the reduced schema and the staged migration plan. Owner: Irene Choi.
- Approve pre-warm capacity for Dedicated Autoscale for first 48 hours. Owner: Marcus Lin — finance will approve a one-time allocation for safety.
- Rollback/contingency triggers accepted as written (schema-compatibility failures, >1% ingestion errors, p95 latency >350ms). Ensure on-call roster is populated and monitored for 72 hours post-launch.

Dylan — please consolidate the final deck with the single risk slide and the contingency playbook, then share to the exec pack folder. We'll do a 10-minute preread at 10:00am on 6/29 and a 15-minute run-through prior to the QBR.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
Links: Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqQBR-Preflight-Readiness
